tok 1.0 "Ordering in an Online Shop"

pool shop "Online shop"
  lane customer "Customer"
    start begin "Customer wants to order"
    task login "Log into the E-Shop"
    xor again
    task select "Select a product"
    task add "Add the product to the shopping cart"
    task save "Save the product"
    xor all "Every product selected?"
    task paydata "Enter the payment data"
    task address "Enter the shipping address"
    xor differs "Billing address different?"
    task billing "Enter the billing address"
    xor merged
  lane system "Shopping system"
    task check "Check the credentials"
    xor ok "Login successful?"
    task finish "Finish the order"
    and split
    and join
    task complete "Complete the order"
    end done "Order completed"
    end stopped "Shopping stopped"
  lane bank "Bank"
    task confirm "Confirm the payment"

flow begin -> login -> check -> ok
flow ok -> again "yes"
flow ok -> stopped "no"
flow again -> select -> add -> save -> all
flow all -> again "no"
flow all -> finish "yes"
flow finish -> split
flow split -> paydata -> confirm -> join
flow split -> address -> differs
flow differs -> billing "yes"
flow differs -> merged "no"
flow billing -> merged
flow merged -> join
flow join -> complete -> done
